findings.description: After stripping the leading dot, the code prepends "." to every no_proxy entry before the endswith check. That includes entries written as IP addresses or CIDR-less literals, and the port-form entries. As a result, an entry like "example.com" now matches only the exact host or subdomains, whereas before it also matched "notexample.com" (suffix match). That part is intended by bpo-39057, but the change also alters behavior for hosts with ports and IPs.
findings.rationale: Trigger: no_proxy="1.2.3.4" or "localhost:8080" with hostname "11.2.3.4". Mechanism: the exact-match branch handles equality, and the dotted suffix handles the rest. Impact: this is consistent with the upstream CPython fix, so it is probably not a real defect.
